title: OpenAI might rebrand its data centers as ‘AI compute campuses’
slides: Why does OpenAI need a new name for data centers?
It reportedly calls them 'AI compute campuses' now
But the rebrand hides rising infrastructure costs
What name you use won't change your API bill
Watch the pricing page, not the press release
thread_text:
1. The real cost signal

OpenAI is rebranding its data centers as 'AI compute campuses' — but the rename does nothing to lower the billions being spent on infrastructure.

2. Why rebrand now?

'Data center' sounds like a commodity; 'campus' sounds strategic. That shift matters as investors scrutinize soaring capex and energy demands.

3. API users feel it

New name or not, your API bill is tied to compute pricing. Rising infrastructure costs will show up there, not in the press release.

4. What to watch

Ignore the branding. Track pricing page updates, rate limits, and usage tiers — those are the real signals of cost pressure.

5. Check your own bill

Pull up your OpenAI usage dashboard and compare last month's cost per token. If it's up, the name change won't soften that number.
